summary.text: Rotting Smell Vicious Cloud is an ancient battle formation that six eggman Gu Immortals from Rotten Egg grotto-heaven can form.

claims.text: Among reinforcements Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch meets while gathering grotto-heaven forces, Rotten Egg grotto-heaven sends six eggman Gu Immortals who can form the ancient battle formation Rotting Smell Vicious Cloud formation. Chaotic Rock grotto-heaven and Strange Hair grotto-heaven bring other trump cards in the same muster, and Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch treats the three nearby grotto-heaven forces as the ones that actually brought serious strength.
When Demon Judgment Board presses the fight, blood-red light and killer moves cover the eggman Gu Immortals in blood. They have to save themselves instead of assembling the ancient battle formation.

On a later battlefield the six eggman Gu Immortals from Rotten Egg grotto-heaven form Rotting Smell Vicious Cloud and trap Nie Kuang Feng for a time. Nie Kuang Feng, inside the formation, shouts that he will send it flying no matter what formation it is, then breaks out from within. The six eggman Gu Immortals spit blood and are either dead or injured.
